note: Employment is defined in line with the [13th ICLS](#dod:13-icls) and includes the production of goods for own use, such as subsistence farming.
title: Labor force participation rates: modeled vs. national estimates
subtitle: Share of the working-age population who are economically active (employed or unemployed). [National estimates](#dod:ilo-national-estimates) use each country's own data collection and definitions. [Modeled estimates](#dod:ilo-modelled-estimates) from the International Labour Organization (ILO) adjust national data to common definitions and use statistical models to fill in years with no reported data.
